policy: FREE_ONLY_NO_CARD_NO_TRIAL_CIRCUMVENTION; verify provider quotas and licenses at each use

providers.name: GitHub Actions public hosted runners
providers.role: CPU automation, Python, Blender headless, GLB validation, renders/previews, tests, index builds
providers.free_tier: Standard public-repository runners free and unlimited; ubuntu-latest 4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, 14 GB SSD at current docs
constraints: No hosted GPU in standard runner
Keep jobs short and deterministic
Public repo is public; never put secrets/assets requiring confidentiality in it

providers.name: Blender
providers.role: Headless mesh cleanup, procedural generation, UV/material processing, GLB export and CPU rendering
constraints: CI runner CPU only
Use -b / --background
Pin Blender version and export settings

providers.name: Poly Haven
providers.role: CC0 PBR textures, HDRIs and models; fetch metadata and downloads
providers.free_tier: CC0 assets free including commercial use
constraints: Record item URL and file hash
Poly Haven API asks for a distinctive User-Agent and live API credit; asset remains CC0

providers.name: ambientCG
providers.role: CC0 PBR materials, HDRIs and selected 3D assets
constraints: Use API v3
Record exact asset id, version, hash and CC0 license

providers.name: Kenney
providers.role: Stylized game props, UI, audio, models
constraints: Verify pack-specific license/version and source file

providers.name: Quaternius
providers.role: Stylized low-poly characters, weapons, props and animation bundles
providers.free_tier: Many published packs CC0; check each pack
constraints: Verify exact pack license and permitted use; log source link

providers.name: KayKit
providers.role: Stylized low-poly environment, characters and props
providers.free_tier: Check each package license; some packs CC0
constraints: Do not assume every pack CC0

providers.name: 3D Valley
providers.role: Search/download CC0 GLB models, rigged characters, animation, textures and audio
providers.free_tier: CC0 library (models, textures, HDRIs, animation, audio); REST API free key currently states 1000 requests/hour and 10000/day for library. Some AI models have free daily runs (e.g. TRELLIS.2 Standard, FLUX.2 klein); others consume purchased credits.
constraints: Use REST API v1; query GET /tools and GET /account before every AI generation batch.
Only dispatch a model when the currently returned price and max_credits are exactly zero for the requested run; otherwise skip and send a review notice.
Set max_credits=0, stable Idempotency-Key, publish=false, and persist job_id before polling GET /jobs/{id}.
API free key limits documented as 1000/hour and 10000/day for library endpoints; 2 concurrent jobs and a default daily spend cap are documented; monitor returned RateLimit headers and account limits.
Library assets are described as CC0, but still record each asset ID, creator/source_url, license and exact original source link in the project manifest.
Any API-backed picker/application displayed to users should show the required 3D Valley link/credit; an asset integrated into the game does not require credit according to its API docs.
Never buy credits, enable card billing, or let a generation exceed zero cost.

providers.name: Hugging Face ZeroGPU
providers.role: Occasional AI 3D/image/texturing model inference via existing community Spaces
providers.free_tier: 5 GPU minutes per day for free accounts; reset 24h after first GPU use
providers.api_key_required: optional for private/authenticated API usage; public Spaces can be accessed without one depending on Space
constraints: Queue/demand-dependent; only short jobs
Use one existing public Space at a time; obey its own license
Track quota and stop cleanly on exhaustion
No account cycling

providers.name: Kaggle Notebooks
providers.role: Occasional scheduled/batch experimentation with GPU models
providers.free_tier: GPU access subject to account quota, weekly cap and availability/queue; published quota can change
constraints: No guaranteed job start or exact GPU SKU
Use only resumable tasks and persist outputs to GitHub/approved storage
Check current quota through account/API at execution time

providers.name: Google Colab
providers.role: Manual/resumable cloud notebook for GPU experimentation
providers.free_tier: Dynamic GPU availability and session limits; not guaranteed API worker or 24/7 service
constraints: No guaranteed always-on scheduling
No automated account cycling
Persist checkpoints and output to repo or external storage

providers.name: JANCTION Render
providers.role: Optional remote Blender rendering; not modeling or texturing generation
providers.free_tier: Current trial/preview credit and free preview quota are limited and subject to change; verify live terms
constraints: No payment method or credit spend allowed in this pipeline
Do not rely on this provider for critical jobs
Inputs/results may be deleted quickly; copy approved outputs and hashes promptly

providers.name: SheepIt Render Farm
providers.role: Community Blender rendering only, not asset modeling or AI generation
providers.free_tier: Community distributed rendering; no confirmed unattended API for this pipeline
constraints: Manual setup and contribution model
Do not make automated dependencies until API/terms confirmed

providers.name: Firebase Spark / Cloud Firestore
providers.role: Optional metadata/status dashboard only; GitHub manifest remains canonical
providers.free_tier: Spark plan includes Firestore no-cost quota (current published example 1 GiB, 50k reads/day, 20k writes/day, 20k deletes/day, 10 GiB egress/month)
constraints: No Cloud Storage or Cloud Functions assumption on Spark; verify current plan matrix
Never store source GLB/texture blobs in Firestore
Use server-side Admin SDK only; secure Security Rules; avoid public write

providers.name: Cloudflare R2
providers.role: Optional binary storage mirror if GitHub repo size becomes unsuitable
providers.free_tier: Monthly included tier currently advertises 10 GB-month storage, 1m Class A, 10m Class B, free egress
constraints: No need in MVP; external mirror must store file hash/version
Usage above free allocation can incur charges; avoid enabling paid overage
Keep canonical GitHub references and restore manifest

providers.name: Telegram Bot API
providers.role: Notifications for new asset review requests, PRs, workflow failures and quota thresholds
providers.free_tier: Bot API HTTPS interface; no API subscription required
constraints: Token from @BotFather is a secret
Get chat_id only after user starts bot or uses a controlled group
Do not send tokens/credentials in notifications

providers.name: n8n Cloud trial
providers.role: Optional workflow orchestrator, exportable/importable JSON only
providers.free_tier: No permanent free plan; standard trial is 14 days / 1000 executions
constraints: Never rotate trial accounts to evade expiry
Before expiration export workflows+credentials and backup encryption key separately
Cloud trial may not expose public API; use UI export or self-host CE

providers.name: n8n Community Edition self-hosted
providers.role: Self-hosted orchestration when server regains internet; repo stores portable workflow JSON not runtime DB/credentials
providers.free_tier: Free under Sustainable Use License for personal/internal business; restrictions apply to hosted service and customer use
constraints: No external service/hosting for customers under standard SUL
Store N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY separately in password manager/secret store
Back up .n8n and external DB; workflows-only export is not full backup
